course_name_original: Análisis e Implantación de Productos Software
course_name_en: Analysis and Implementation of Software Products
prerequisites: Competencies corresponding to the course "TIC Products and Services"
Ability to read and understand documentation written in English

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to analyze information needs in an environment and carry out the entire process of building an information system in all its stages.
Perform an analysis of an information system, identifying the different needs of the involved parties and the integration needs with other systems.
Manage the analysis process and evaluate it.
Evaluate alternatives and develop a technical solution that satisfies the fixed requirements.

syllabus_topics: Analysis of the organization's process map. Definition of objectives, organizational structure, and stakeholders.
Modeling of business processes and information needs. Alternatives and technical solution.

Alternatives and technical solutions oriented to specific purposes (e.g., system integration, Data Warehousing, Big Data Engineering). Methodological support for the coordinated project carried out during the course.
Alternatives and technical solutions in specific sectors (e.g., packaged ERP software, air traffic management, etc.).
Preparation of a technical presentation to stakeholders and evaluation.

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory Practices (teamwork, continuous monitoring, report delivery, final presentation)
Theory Assignments (individual and/or team, class participation)

assessment_rules: For ordinary examination, each of the three blocks (Laboratory Practices, Theory Assignments, Presential Exam) must be approved with a minimum score of 5 out of 10. For teamwork in laboratory practices, attendance and presentation of the work are mandatory. If all minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: 0.6 * Lab. Practices + 0.2 * Theory Assignments + 0.2 * Presential Exam. If an exemption from the final exam is granted (based on sufficient participation and at least 80% attendance in theory classes), the formula changes to (0.6 * Lab. Practices + 0.2 * Theory Assignments) * 10/8. Otherwise, the final grade is the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. In extraordinary examination, if approved in ordinary, Lab Practices and Theory Assignments grades are considered (or 0 if not approved); a new Presential Exam is taken, requiring a minimum of 5.0. The final grade is 0.6 * New Presential Exam + 0.4 * Combined Assignments (0.25 * Theory Assignments + 0.75 * Lab. Practices).
